etymologies.etymologyHTML: From truth +‎ -ful.

definitions.definition: Honest, and always telling the truth.

quote.citation: 1850, Edgar Allan Poe, “The Poetic Principle”, in The Works of the Late Edgar Allan Poe, volume III:
quote.text: He must be blind indeed who does not perceive the radical and chasmal difference between the truthful and the poetical modes of inculcation.
